card.title: Say the Scary Part
card.instruction: Get someone else to name the frightening possibility or vulnerable feeling before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before our skating qualifier, can you say the possibility we keep avoiding?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want you carrying that onto the ice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm carrying it already. I just need you to say it first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We might not qualify. I'd still want to skate with you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why did I need that second sentence so much? Could you name that fear too?

mechanism: A asks B to name both competitive failure and the relational fear exposed by reassurance.
confusable: Unlike seeking general comfort, A must keep the feared wording with B before naming it themself.
comparison: D104-b uses the unasked promise of continued skating to expose a deeper unnamed fear; D104-a asks for the judgment implied by a lost shop.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
